contract.intent: The gate card must tell the TRUTH about the node it is showing, not about the page's snapshot. Today clicking a task with no undecided gate renders the gate-card chrome with a (disabled) Accept/Reject pair, which reads as 'you can decide this'; and if a gate was decided elsewhere (CLI, another tab) the page still offers the decision — and a click would write a REDUNDANT decision (gate! auto-submits when nothing is undecided). Fix: the card is bound to the NODE's actual gate state from /api/confirm (detail.gates), so it (a) shows the decision UI ONLY when the addressed gate is genuinely `submitted`, (b) otherwise says what is true — the gate is already decided (with its state and date) or there is no undecided gate — plus a `next` line saying what the task is waiting for (queued with no submission · entry confirmed, work not started · work in progress · waiting on a decision in the queue · accepted, awaiting the close · closed), (c) re-checks the gate state immediately before writing and refuses locally when it went stale, and (d) refreshes on focus/visibility and via a Refresh control so an external decision lands in the view.
acceptanceCriteria: the card's decision UI is shown ONLY when the addressed gate's state is `submitted` (from the card's own /api/confirm read); otherwise it is absent (not disabled-and-visible) and the card states what is true: the gate is already <confirmed|rejected> on <date>, or the node has no undecided gate

every card carries a `next` line derived from the node's status + gate states — one of: queued and not yet submitted at the entry gate · entry confirmed, work not started · work in progress · waiting on a decision (naming the gate in the queue) · accepted, awaiting the close (naming complete!) · closed — so a `queued` task never looks decidable

a decision is re-checked immediately before the write: if the addressed gate is no longer `submitted`, the page refuses locally, says it was stale and refreshes — it never posts a redundant decision (the write path that gate! auto-submits on)
the page refreshes the journey + queue on window focus/visibility change and has an explicit Refresh control with an 'as of' timestamp, so an external decision cannot leave the view silently stale
the full suite stays green (the served-page structural assertions cover the state-truth words + the guard), ann check/verify stay clean, committed with evidence incl. claims/checks
